REPORT
35-4
5-11-43
S-3; Foreign Affairs Station. File No. Date 6-20-43
SUBJECT: Activities of Miss Elsie Wong.
特六科長
要在意人物
（印：山 口 18.10.-7）
FILE
Further to the activities of Miss Elsie Wong, British educated HongKong born-Chinese girl, 24 years of age, the following information has been obtained:-
Miss Wong arrived from HongKong about two months ago with a Chinese named Chan Kok Yeo, Cantonese, aged about 30. They were residing at the Park Hotel until about two weeks ago.
About 6 months ago, Miss Wong was in very poor financial circumstances in HongKong. Her mother, also a Chinese was the concubine of a British subject named Williams in HongKong. Before the outbreak of the Pacific War the Wong family was very well connected with several Chungking officials and used to entertain visiting officials in HongKong quite frequently. Mr. Williams, (Miss Wong's) step-father was well off financially. Most of their circles of friends were British and Chinese people of influence in HongKong.
Shortly before the outbreak of the Pacific War Miss Wong left HongKong for Singapore with her brother

报告
35-4
1943年11月5日
S-3；外事股。档案号 日期 1943年6月20日
主题：黄爱茜（Elsie Wong）小姐的活动。
特六科长
重要人物
（印：山口 18.10.-7）
存档
继关于黄爱茜小姐活动的调查之后，现获得如下情报。黄小姐为在香港出生的华人女性，受英式教育，现年24岁。
黄小姐约于两个月前与一名叫陈国尧（Chan Kok Yeo，音译）的华人一同从香港抵达。陈系广东人，年龄约30岁。两人一直居住在派克饭店（Park Hotel），直至约两周前。
约六个月前，黄小姐在香港的经济状况十分拮据。其母亦为华人，是香港一名英籍人士威廉斯（Williams）先生的妾室。在太平洋战争爆发前，黄家与数名重庆官员关系密切，并经常在香港宴请来访官员。黄小姐的继父威廉斯先生经济宽裕。他们的朋友圈多为在香港具有影响力的英国人和华人。
太平洋战争爆发前不久，黄小姐与其弟离开香港前往新加坡

SUBJECT:
Mr. Sidney Wong, also a person of questionable character
who was in the HonKong Volunteer Defence Corps before
the outbreak of the Pacific War. They returned to HongKong
some time after the fall of the Singapore and were engaged
in various black market transactions in HongKong.
Recently, Miss Wong acquired a large sum of money
but it is not known how she obtained such a large sum.
Her step-father Mr. Williams was sent to the internment
Camp in Hong Kong and very shortly after, Miss Wong's
met or befriended a Japanese Army official, a Colonel
in the Imperial Japanese Army in HongKong and this official
is supporting the Wong family in HongKong now and it was
through his influence that Miss Wong was able to come to
Shanghai with Mr. Chan Hok Yee by plane .
With the money Miss Wong and Mr. Chan have
acquired, they have now established a shop in 130, Bubbling
Well Road and the re-opening of this shop will take place
on October 10, 1943.(Newspaper cutting attached herewith.)
Morris Gashkowitz
D.P.S.

........................................分局。档案号.................... 日期....................................
主题：
其弟西德尼·黄（Sidney Wong）先生也是一名背景可疑之人，
他在太平洋战争爆发前曾服役于香港义勇防卫队。
新加坡沦陷后一段时间，他们返回香港，并在香港从事
各种黑市交易。
近期，黄小姐获得了一大笔款项，
但尚不清楚她是如何获得如此巨款的。
她的继父威廉斯先生被送入香港的拘禁营，
此后不久，黄小姐结识或交好了一名日本陆军军官，
即驻香港的大日本帝国陆军上校。目前该官员正在资助
在香港的黄家，黄小姐正是通过他的影响力，
得以与陈国尧（Chan Hok Yee，音译）先生乘飞机来到上海。
利用黄小姐和陈先生获得的资金，
他们已在静安寺路130号开设了一家店铺，
该店将于1943年10月10日重新开业。（附剪报一份。）
莫里斯·加什科维茨（Morris Gashkowitz）
副警务总监

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
Station S-3; Foreign Affairs File No. Date 20-9-43
SUBJECT:
（批：特务科長 山本 分送）
Miss Elsie Wong, Cantonese, British-educated
young girl, about 24 years of age has arrived from
Hongkong about one month ago and is residing at the
Park Hotel with a young Chinese, name unknown, who
also arrived with her from Hongkong by plane.
Before the outbreak of the Pacific War, Miss Wong
was connected with several well-known Chungking politicians
who used to make frequent trips to
Singapore, Borneo and Java.
（印：查）
Morris Gershkowitz

S-3分局；外事档案号 日期 1943年9月20日
主题：
（批：特务科长 山本 分送）
黄爱茜（Elsie Wong）小姐，广东人，受英式教育的
年轻女子，约24岁，约一个月前从
香港抵达，现与一名年轻华人居住在
派克饭店（Park Hotel）。该男子姓名不详，
亦与她一同乘飞机从香港抵达。
太平洋战争爆发前，黄小姐
与数名知名的重庆政界人士有往来，
这些人曾频繁往返于
新加坡、婆罗洲和爪哇。
（印：查）
莫里斯·格什科维茨（Morris Gershkowitz）
